sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Tools
sources.exact_requirement_used: Tool annotations are untrusted hints; clients should consider the tool description and annotations untrusted unless they come from trusted servers.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture hosts exercise listing, calls, annotations, pagination, and list-change invalidation; no live-host support is inferred.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Prompts
sources.exact_requirement_used: Prompt discovery and prompt retrieval are separate operations and list responses may be paginated.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture servers expose descriptor and retrieved-content differences.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Resources
sources.exact_requirement_used: Resource discovery and resource reads are separate operations and list responses may be paginated.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture servers expose descriptor and read-content differences.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Tasks
sources.exact_requirement_used: Tasks are experimental, capability-negotiated durable state machines with retrieval and cancellation operations.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Only the program-owned fixture task service claims support.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Authorization
sources.exact_requirement_used: Authorization uses OAuth protected-resource metadata and resource indicators and requires token audience validation.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Only synthetic OAuth resources and authorization servers are exercised.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Elicitation
sources.exact_requirement_used: URL elicitation completion must be associated with the initiating interaction and clients must present destination identity.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture-only URL completion binding.

sources.title: SEP-2567: Sessionless MCP and explicit state
sources.exact_requirement_used: Explicit state handles must be treated as state references rather than proof of authorization.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture state handles model the proposal; no released-core claim is made.

sources.title: SEP-2260: Require server requests to be associated with client requests
sources.exact_requirement_used: Server-originated requests require a live, valid parent client request association.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture host correlation behavior only.

sources.title: SEP-2243: HTTP standardization
sources.exact_requirement_used: Mcp-Method mirrors the case-sensitive JSON-RPC method and Mcp-Name mirrors the applicable params.name; implementations processing the body reject disagreement, while HTTP header names remain case-insensitive.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture parser differential only.

sources.title: MCP Apps extension specification
sources.exact_requirement_used: App messages, tool visibility, resource templates, and host mediation are bound to an app lifecycle and server connection.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture app host only; no installed MCP App host is claimed.

sources.title: WebMCP repository
sources.exact_requirement_used: Web tool registrations are document and frame lifecycle state whose exposure depends on origin policy.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: A faithful fixture lifecycle model is used; browser implementation support is not generalized.

sources.title: ACP RFD: Additional directories
sources.exact_requirement_used: Additional filesystem roots expand authority and require exact canonical root enforcement.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Fixture ACP client path checks only.

sources.title: RFC 9728: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata
sources.exact_requirement_used: Protected resources publish authorization-server metadata locations that clients retrieve and validate.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic metadata fetcher only.

sources.title: RFC 8707: Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0
sources.exact_requirement_used: Tokens are audience-bound to the requested protected resource.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic audience checking only.

sources.title: RFC 9207: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Issuer Identification
sources.exact_requirement_used: Authorization responses identify the issuer so clients can prevent authorization-server mix-up.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic issuer mix-up fixture only.

sources.title: RFC 8252: OAuth 2.0 for Native Apps
sources.exact_requirement_used: Loopback redirects use ephemeral ports and authorization-code flows use PKCE and exact state binding.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic callback race only; no real identity provider.

sources.title: OAuth Client ID Metadata Document draft
sources.exact_requirement_used: An HTTPS client identifier resolves to metadata, but redirect targets still require visible validation and binding.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic client metadata only.

sources.title: JSON Schema Core 2020-12
sources.exact_requirement_used: Reference resolution and recursive evaluation are explicit validation operations requiring bounded resource handling.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Program-owned bounded schema evaluator.

sources.title: Official MCP Go SDK
sources.exact_requirement_used: Cross-origin behavior is version- and configuration-specific and must be tested against an exact installed version.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: None until an isolated exact SDK version is available.

sources.title: Official MCP Python SDK
sources.exact_requirement_used: Request-envelope behavior is version- and dispatch-path-specific and must be tested through the exact installed SDK schemas.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Exact cached mcp 1.28.1 transport and ClientRequest schemas are exercised in qualified containment.

sources.title: Official MCP TypeScript SDK
sources.exact_requirement_used: Request-envelope behavior is version- and dispatch-path-specific and must be tested through the exact installed SDK schemas.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Exact cached @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0 JSONRPCMessageSchema and CallToolRequestSchema are exercised in qualified containment.

sources.title: Runtime scanner reliability study
sources.exact_requirement_used: Static and descriptor-only scanner observations should not be represented as runtime behavioral proof.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Motivates evidence ceilings only; the paper is not an execution oracle.

sources.title: Read-only local target source snapshots
sources.exact_requirement_used: Target-specific claims are limited to the exact read-only commit or isolated copy recorded in the result.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Subject digests and deviations must be recorded before any target-scoped result.

sources.title: MHAI fixture safety invariant
sources.exact_requirement_used: Synthetic effects may touch only program-owned canaries and exact run-owned sockets inside qualified containment.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Program harness.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28 core and versioning
sources.exact_requirement_used: Current MCP requests carry protocol version and client capabilities per request; optional extensions require explicit support and otherwise fall back or reject.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Task Lease Guard fixture capability decisions only; no live client or server conformance claim.

sources.title: MCP Tasks extension
sources.exact_requirement_used: The io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension defines server-directed durable tasks, task lifecycle and polling fields, cooperative cancellation, tasks/get result custody, and nested input requests; its hosted page remains labelled Draft despite SEP-2663 Final status.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Versioned Task Lease Guard fixtures only; specification conflicts and underspecified requirements remain UNKNOWN.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Authorization 2026-07-28
sources.exact_requirement_used: Authorization is optional overall and transport-specific; authenticated caller identity and token audience must not be inferred where the transport supplies no authorization evidence.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic requestor and context-binding fixtures only; no authorization-provider behavior is claimed.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Elicitation 2026-07-28
sources.exact_requirement_used: Elicitation capability and user binding apply per request; form elicitation must not request sensitive information, which requires a URL-mode flow.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic task-nested elicitation trust checks only.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Sampling 2026-07-28
sources.exact_requirement_used: Sampling is deprecated in the 2026-07-28 core; task-nested sampling retains its ordinary capability and trust checks and is not required for current conformance.
sources.local_implementation_claims_support: Synthetic deprecated-compatibility fixtures only; no model-provider or installed-host behavior is claimed.
